<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=How Old Are You?|id=A0092}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
We are entering dangerous territory: questions about age. Get your compliments ready, someone might be fishing! But first JP and Liliana give us the keyword of this lesson: '''años''' — years.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0056|A0056: What time is the train?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0086|A0086: Are you single?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0112|A0112: What is your telephone number?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Cuántos años tienes?'''
| How old are you?
| '''Tengo treinta años.'''
| I'm thirty years old.
| '''Pareces más joven.'''
| You seem younger.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
| Thanks a lot.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿Cuántos años tienes?'''
| How old are you?
| '''Tengo treinta años.'''
| I'm thirty years old.
| '''Pareces más joven.'''
| You seem younger.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
| Thanks a lot.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| How old are you?
| '''¿Cuántos años tienes?'''
| I'm thirty years old.
| '''Tengo treinta años.'''
| You seem younger.
| '''Pareces más joven.'''
| Thanks a lot.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| How old are you?
| '''¿Cuántos años tienes?'''
| I'm thirty years old.
| '''Tengo treinta años.'''
| You seem younger.
| '''Pareces más joven.'''
| Thanks a lot.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| How old are you? 25? 
| '''¿Cuántos años tienes? ¿Veinticinco?'''
| Many more!
| '''¡Muchos más!'''
| More than ({{=}} '''de''') 35 years?
| '''¿Más de treinta y cinco años?'''
| Thanks a lot!
| '''¡Muchas gracias!'''
| How many?
| '''¿Cuántos?'''
| I'm 29 years old.
| '''Tengo veintinueve años.'''
| You seem younger.
| '''Pareces más joven.'''
| Thanks, youngster.
| '''Gracias, joven.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| How old are you? 25? 
| '''¿Cuántos años tienes? ¿Veinticinco?'''
| Many more!
| '''¡Muchos más!'''
| More than ({{=}} '''de''') 35 years?
| '''¿Más de treinta y cinco años?'''
| Thanks a lot!
| '''¡Muchas gracias!'''
| How many?
| '''¿Cuántos?'''
| I'm 29 years old.
| '''Tengo veintinueve años.'''
| You seem younger.
| '''Pareces más joven.'''
| Thanks, youngster.
| '''Gracias, joven.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| How old are you? (formal)
| '''¿Cuántos años tiene (usted)?'''
| I'm fifty years old.
| '''Tengo cincuenta años.'''
| You seem younger. (formal)
| '''(Usted) parece más joven.'''
| Thanks a lot.
| '''Muchas gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
